description: Elections Commission - Notice that the Supplementary Electoral Register 2023(3) has been Certified under the Registration of Electors Act
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the certification and public notice of the Supplementary Electoral Register 2023(3) under the Registration of Electors Act. It specifically deals with electoral processes, including the registration of new voters who attained voting age and the official certification of electoral registers. This content falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral registers, voter registration matters, and election administration.
